body: The owner asked whether the items found in the last three reviews are regressions. None is a regression; each existed at 9b80901 or came from a spec gap.U+000AU+000AU+002D **Mood prompt double read.** _MoodPrompt had the same Semantics(label: text) around its own Text and FlowerBloom at 9b80901. The first wave only changed the change button.U+000AU+002D **Viewer pill duplicate nodes.** log_actions_pill.dart is unchanged between 9b80901 and 3832126.U+000AU+002D **Card unlabelled button.** The same Semantics(container, button, onTap) plus GestureDetector(onTap) was at 9b80901.U+000AU+002D **Composer Cancel/Save and unlabelled editor node.** A semantics dump of TextComposerSheet at 9b80901 and at 04f07d0 shows identical Cancel/Save nodes (tap, not button) and the same unlabelled tap node.U+000AU+002D **C2 single line break.** This is the original defect. My spec narrowed it to a blank line.U+000AU+002D **Screen-reader ticking.** Ticking outside the editor did not exist before H14. The H14 spec never required the semantics path.U+000AU+002D **More formats lingering nodes.** Not reproducible at 04f07d0. The first run already noted the menu items reporting zero-size bounds to accessibility.U+000AU+000ACause of the drip: the first review's accessibility check sampled screens and recorded obvious gaps, the owner then scoped H13 to named controls only, and each later pass dumped more screens. A whole-screen semantics sweep, as an automated lint, would close the list in one pass.
